caption: The drawing depicts a framed religious icon centered within an ornate, rectangular structure. The frame is illustrated in grayscale with decorative patterns that include flowers and dot motifs along the borders, as well as carved, radiating lines at the top forming a fan-like crown. On either side of the frame, wing-like ornamental shapes extend outward. Within the frame, a colored image of a robed female figure stands on a crescent moon supported by a cherubic face, with gold rays radiating from behind her. The figure wears a blue cloak with gold stars over a rose-colored tunic. The background inside the frame is shaded in gray tones. A smaller, labeled side-view sketch of the same framed object appears at the bottom right of the page, also executed in grayscale. The main colors present are blue, gold, rose, and various shades of gray. The drawing is executed on an off-white paper.
title: Tin Nicho Containing Guadalupe Bulto
